text:
Zoe Park: Random idea  midweek dumpling potluck + jigsaw puzzle night at the atrium? Wednesday after work, say 6pm. dumplings + tea = bliss. :dumpling::tea:
Hector Ramos: i'm very into this. i'll bring a big batch of pork dumplings (and chopsticks).
Amara Okafor: i can make veggie dumplings and bring hot sauce. also have a 500-piece skyline puzzle we can start.
Noah Kim: can we have a low-competition cornhole setup too? two games at once? 
Zoe Park: lol keep it chill. puzzles + light games only. cornhole is allowed if it's not intense.
Hector Ramos: quick vote  bring a puzzle (:jigsaw:) or bring board games (:game_die:)? react with your pick.
Amara Okafor: :jigsaw:
Noah Kim: :game_die: (i can bring Codenames though)
Zoe Park: :jigsaw: leaning puzzle so people can dip in/out.
devs-bot: FYI: Atrium reservation available 6-9pm. Please keep noise level to normal workplace rules.
Amara Okafor: heads-up: i've got a small steamer but limited plugs. anyone got an extension cord?
Noah Kim: office-supplies closet has one, i'll fetch it and bring a power strip.
Hector Ramos: dietary note: i'll label my tray with allergens. others please do the same so people know.
Zoe Park: RSVP so i can estimate plates: Zoe, Hector, Amara, Noah. can others drop a quick yes/no?
calendar-bot: Event created "Midweek Dumplings & Puzzle Night" Wednesday 6:00 PM. RSVP: https://cal.example.com/event/9903
Zoe Park: posted the link. feel free to bring a +1 but mark them on the RSVP. see you there ":sparkles:"
